The aristocrat appeared in "[[Chapter 19: The Convert]]," the nineteenth episode of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'', which was directed by [[Lee Isaac Chung]].<ref name="Chapter 19" /> [[Valarie Pettiford]] portrayed the character.<ref name="Chapter 19" />
